verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes a headline NPU TOPS figure (85 TOPS) and ships developer tooling today (AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub, GenieX runtime, 300+ optimized models) independent of the chip's 2026 hardware launch. However, the vendor page explicitly does not state the precision for the 85 TOPS figure, and community commentary notes the absence of independent benchmarks to verify AI performance claims. Missing for 10: precision (e.g., INT8/INT4) disclosure for the TOPS number, and independent hands-on validation of NPU throughput/SDK maturity.
